module.purpose: Implements React's Fiber commit-phase view transition orchestration: applying/restoring view-transition names, pairing appearing/exiting transitions, measuring layout changes, and scheduling transition events for enter/exit/update gestures.
module.summary: This module contains the commit-phase logic for React's View Transitions API integration in the reconciler. It walks Fiber trees during before-mutation, mutation, and layout phases to assign CSS view-transition names to host instances, match named appearing/deleting pairs, measure geometry to detect layout-affecting changes, and invoke configured callbacks (onEnter, onExit, onShare, onUpdate, gesture variants). It manages module-level mutable state tracking pending pairs and cancelable children, and respects feature flags for persistence mode and parent enter/exit animations. The code is purely synchronous and mutates Fiber flags and state nodes directly.
module.businessContext: Powers smooth animated route/layout transitions in React apps. If broken, UI transitions fail, pairs mismatch, or layout shifts animate incorrectly.
